tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 12th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 12th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. The disowned self is buried in the unconscious; raw instinct you may not see, surfacing in private. The disowned self buried in the unconscious: at once a wound and a gateway. Unexamined it blocks expression; explored, it becomes a source of intuitive depth.
business: The disowned self activates through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat. Reclaiming hidden power and refusing to disappear brings it to light.
shadow: Self-sabotage from the dark, or suppressed feelings slipping out as passive-aggressive behavior.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 12th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
